# Device reference

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs` from the source code. Do not edit; CI checks it. -->

Every device kind Hardless emulates, its settings (the `config` of `POST /api/v1/devices`, the config file or the Playwright fixture) and the faults it supports. Faults are described in the [fault reference](faults.md).

## `printer-escpos`

An ESC/POS receipt printer. It parses each job into a command AST, answers `DLE EOT` status requests, kicks an attached cash drawer and renders receipts at 58 or 80 mm. `transport` says how the app reaches it: Web Serial (`serial`), WebUSB (`usb`) or the HTTP printer endpoints (`http`).

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `autoSelect` | boolean | `false` | Let the shim's port picker choose this device without asking. |
| `drawerOpenLevel` | `high` or `low` | `"high"` | The drawer sensor level that means "open" in `DLE EOT 1` bit 2. |
| `idleMs` | integer | `300` | Silence in milliseconds after which an open job closes. |
| `ieee1284Id` | string | none | USB: the IEEE 1284 device ID returned by the printer-class `GET_DEVICE_ID` request (default `MFG:Hardless;MDL:<product name>;CMD:ESC/POS;CLS:PRINTER;`). |
| `manufacturerName` | string | none | USB: the manufacturer string descriptor (default `Hardless`). |
| `paperWidth` | integer | `80` | Paper width in millimetres: 58 or 80. |
| `productName` | string | none | USB: the product string descriptor (default `Virtual Receipt Printer`). |
| `serialNumber` | string | none | USB: the serial number string descriptor (default: the device ID). |
| `transport` | `serial` or `http` or `usb` | `"serial"` | How the app reaches the printer: `serial` (default), `usb` or `http`. |
| `usbProductId` | integer | none | USB product ID reported by `SerialPort.getInfo()` and `USBDevice.productId` (needs `usbVendorId`). |
| `usbVendorId` | integer | none | USB vendor ID reported by `SerialPort.getInfo()` and `USBDevice.vendorId` (a USB printer without one reports pid.codes `0x1209`). |

Faults: `paper-out`, `paper-near-end`, `cover-open`, `offline`, `disconnect-mid-write`, `slow-write`, `baud-mismatch`, `garbled`, `picker-cancel`, `timeout`, `cors-blocked`, `stall`, `interface-busy`.

## `cash-drawer`

A cash drawer plugged into a printer's drawer-kick connector. It opens when the printer gets a kick on its pin (ESC/POS `ESC p`, an ePOS `pulse`, a WebPRNT drawer command), and closes by hand or after `autoCloseMs`. The printer reports it in its status.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `attachedTo` | string | required | The printer this drawer is plugged into. |
| `autoCloseMs` | integer | none | Close automatically this many milliseconds after opening. Off by default. |
| `pin` | integer | `2` | The connector pin that kicks this drawer: 2 or 5. |

Faults: `jammed`, `not-connected`.

## `scanner-wedge`

A keyboard-wedge barcode scanner: it types each scan into the page's focused field, a few milliseconds per key, then a terminator key.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `delayMs` | integer | `8` | Milliseconds between key presses (default 8). |
| `prefix` | string | `""` | Characters typed before every code. |
| `suffix` | string | `""` | Characters typed after every code, before the terminator. |
| `terminator` | string | `"enter"` | The key pressed after each code: `enter` (default), `tab` or `none`. |

Faults: `double-scan`, `partial-scan`.

## `nfc-reader`

An NFC reader with virtual cards, for Web NFC (`NDEFReader`). A tap puts a card on the reader for `presenceMs` and reads it; while it is there the app can write to it or lock it. The reader remembers cards and what was written to them.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cards` | array | `[]` | Cards the reader knows from the start. |
| `presenceMs` | integer | `2000` | How long a tapped card stays on the reader, in milliseconds (default 2000). |

Faults: `picker-cancel`, `permission-denied`, `read-error`.
